import requests, numpy as np, pandas as pd, json, re
from scipy import stats
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt
h={"User-Agent":"openscientist/1.0"}
aa="A R N D C Q E G H I L K M F P S T W Y V".split()
raw="""4 -1 -2 -2 0 -1 -1 0 -2 -1 -1 -1 -1 -2 -1 1 0 -3 -2 0
-1 5 0 -2 -3 1 0 -2 0 -3 -2 2 -1 -3 -2 -1 -1 -3 -2 -3
-2 0 6 1 -3 0 0 0 1 -3 -3 0 -2 -3 -2 1 0 -4 -2 -3
-2 -2 1 6 -3 0 2 -1 -1 -3 -4 -1 -3 -3 -1 0 -1 -4 -3 -3
0 -3 -3 -3 9 -3 -4 -3 -3 -1 -1 -3 -1 -2 -3 -1 -1 -2 -2 -1
-1 1 0 0 -3 5 2 -2 0 -3 -2 1 0 -3 -1 0 -1 -2 -1 -2
-1 0 0 2 -4 2 5 -2 0 -3 -3 1 -2 -3 -1 0 -1 -3 -2 -2
0 -2 0 -1 -3 -2 -2 6 -2 -4 -4 -2 -3 -3 -2 0 -2 -2 -3 -3
-2 0 1 -1 -3 0 0 -2 8 -3 -3 -1 -2 -1 -2 -1 -2 -2 2 -3
-1 -3 -3 -3 -1 -3 -3 -4 -3 4 2 -3 1 0 -3 -2 -1 -3 -1 3
-1 -2 -3 -4 -1 -2 -3 -4 -3 2 4 -2 2 0 -3 -2 -1 -2 -1 1
-1 2 0 -1 -3 1 1 -2 -1 -3 -2 5 -1 -3 -1 0 -1 -3 -2 -2
-1 -1 -2 -3 -1 0 -2 -3 -2 1 2 -1 5 0 -2 -1 -1 -1 -1 1
-2 -3 -3 -3 -2 -3 -3 -3 -1 0 0 -3 0 6 -4 -2 -2 1 3 -1
-1 -2 -2 -1 -3 -1 -1 -2 -2 -3 -3 -1 -2 -4 7 -1 -1 -4 -3 -2
1 -1 1 0 -1 0 0 0 -1 -2 -2 0 -1 -2 -1 4 1 -3 -2 -2
0 -1 0 -1 -1 -1 -1 -2 -2 -1 -1 -1 -1 -2 -1 1 5 -2 -2 0
-3 -3 -4 -4 -2 -2 -3 -2 -2 -3 -2 -3 -1 1 -4 -3 -2 11 2 -3
-2 -2 -2 -3 -2 -1 -2 -3 2 -1 -1 -2 -1 3 -3 -2 -2 2 7 -1
0 -3 -3 -3 -1 -2 -2 -3 -3 3 1 -2 1 -1 -2 -2 0 -3 -1 4"""
idx={c:i for i,c in enumerate(aa)}
Bm=np.array([[int(v) for v in ln.split()] for ln in raw.strip().split("\n")],dtype=np.int16)
def enc(s): return np.array([idx.get(c,-1) for c in s],dtype=np.int16)
ref="".join(requests.get("https://rest.uniprot.org/uniprotkb/A8FNH9.fasta",headers=h,timeout=60).text.split("\n")[1:]).strip()
W=10
def win(p): a=p-1-W; return (ref[a:p+W], W) if a>=0 and p+W<=len(ref) else None
def scan(target,wlist,minscore=10):
    te=enc(target); out=[]
    for w,off in wlist:
        we=enc(w); L=len(we)
        if len(te)<L: out.append((None,-999)); continue
        sl=np.lib.stride_tricks.sliding_window_view(te,L)
        sc=np.where((sl>=0)&(we>=0),Bm[np.clip(sl,0,19),np.clip(we,0,19)],0).sum(1)
        k=int(np.argmax(sc)); best=int(sc[k])
        out.append((target[k+off] if best>=minscore else None,best))
    return out

POCKET=[41,169,170,236,272,314,342,346,350]
rng=np.random.default_rng(0)
cand=[p for p in range(W+1,len(ref)-W) if p not in POCKET]
BG=sorted(rng.choice(cand,120,replace=False).tolist())
pock_w=[win(p) for p in POCKET]; bg_w=[win(p) for p in BG]

r=requests.get("https://rest.uniprot.org/uniprotkb/search",
  params={"query":"xref:interpro-IPR005730","fields":"accession,organism_name,lineage,sequence","format":"tsv","size":500},
  headers=h,timeout=180)
lines=r.text.strip().split("\n"); hdr=lines[0].split("\t")
recs=[dict(zip(hdr,ln.split("\t"))) for ln in lines[1:] if len(ln.split("\t"))>=4]
print(f"family entries analysed: {len(recs)} of {r.headers.get('x-total-results')} total in IPR005730")

Pc=np.empty((len(recs),len(POCKET)),dtype=object); Bg=np.empty((len(recs),len(BG)),dtype=object)
phyla=[]
for i,rec in enumerate(recs):
    s=rec["Sequence"]
    Pc[i]=[x[0] for x in scan(s,pock_w)]
    Bg[i]=[x[0] for x in scan(s,bg_w)]
    lin=rec["Taxonomic lineage"]
    m=re.findall(r"([A-Za-z]+) \(phylum\)",lin); phyla.append(m[0] if m else "unknown")

refaa={p:ref[p-1] for p in POCKET}
pock_cons=[]; 
print("\nPosition            n_mapped  %identical to C. jejuni  most common alternatives")
for j,p in enumerate(POCKET):
    col=[x for x in Pc[:,j] if x]
    f=np.mean([c==refaa[p] for c in col]); pock_cons.append(f)
    alt=pd.Series([c for c in col if c!=refaa[p]]).value_counts().head(3).to_dict()
    print(f"  {refaa[p]}{p:<5}{'(Deng Leu314)' if p==314 else '':15s} {len(col):5d}      {100*f:6.2f}%            {alt}")
bg_cons=[]
for j,p in enumerate(BG):
    col=[x for x in Bg[:,j] if x]
    if len(col)>=0.8*len(recs): bg_cons.append(np.mean([c==ref[p-1] for c in col]))
pock_cons=np.array(pock_cons); bg_cons=np.array(bg_cons)
U,pU=stats.mannwhitneyu(pock_cons,bg_cons,alternative="greater")
print(f"\nmean identity at the 9 polyamine-contact positions: {100*pock_cons.mean():.2f}%  (median {100*np.median(pock_cons):.2f}%)")
print(f"mean identity at {len(bg_cons)} random control positions: {100*bg_cons.mean():.2f}%  (median {100*np.median(bg_cons):.2f}%)")
print(f"Mann-Whitney U={U:.0f}, one-sided p={pU:.3e}; rank-biserial effect size r={2*U/(len(pock_cons)*len(bg_cons))-1:.3f}")
print(f"control positions reaching >=95% identity: {np.mean(bg_cons>=0.95)*100:.1f}%")

# Does the one variable position track phylum?
j236=POCKET.index(236)
tab=pd.crosstab(pd.Series(phyla,name="phylum"),pd.Series([x if x else "unmapped" for x in Pc[:,j236]],name="residue_at_E236_equiv"))
keep=tab.sum(1).sort_values(ascending=False).head(6).index
print("\nResidue at the C. jejuni Glu236 position, by phylum (top 6 phyla):")
print(tab.loc[keep].loc[:,tab.loc[keep].sum(0).sort_values(ascending=False).head(5).index].to_string())
np.save("/tmp/x.npy",np.array([0]))
pd.DataFrame({"position":[f"{refaa[p]}{p}" for p in POCKET],"pct_identical":100*pock_cons}).to_csv("family_pocket_conservation.csv",index=False)
tab.to_csv("E236_position_by_phylum.csv")

fig,ax=plt.subplots(1,2,figsize=(14,5))
ax[0].hist(100*bg_cons,bins=25,color="#b0b7c3",label=f"{len(bg_cons)} random control positions")
for f,p in zip(pock_cons,POCKET):
    ax[0].axvline(100*f,color="#2f5d9e" if p!=236 else "crimson",lw=2)
ax[0].set_xlabel("% identical to C. jejuni NspC across 500 family members")
ax[0].set_ylabel("number of control positions")
ax[0].set_title(f"Polyamine-contact positions (blue lines; red = Glu236 equivalent)\nversus background, Mann-Whitney p = {pU:.1e}",fontsize=10)
ax[0].legend(fontsize=8)
sub=tab.loc[keep]; sub=sub.loc[:,sub.sum(0).sort_values(ascending=False).head(4).index]
sub.plot(kind="barh",stacked=True,ax=ax[1],color=["#2f5d9e","#e08a3c","#7fa8d4","#b0b7c3"])
ax[1].set_xlabel("number of family members"); ax[1].set_ylabel("")
ax[1].set_title("Residue at the one variable contact position (C. jejuni Glu236)\nsplits by phylum, not by assigned substrate",fontsize=10)
plt.tight_layout(); plt.show()
